description: A composite figure of three parts for three low-density steel conditions printed as AN750-T, AN800-T and AN850-T. (a) "Before reconstruction": three inverse-pole-figure (IPF) colour maps of the as-measured microstructure, one per condition (left AN750-T, middle AN800-T, right AN850-T), each with a 20 µm scale bar; an IPF colour triangle at the top right keys 001, 101 and 111. Grains are comparatively equiaxed in AN750-T and become increasingly banded/elongated in AN800-T and AN850-T. (b) "Parent grain analysis": the corresponding reconstructed parent-grain maps for the same three conditions in the same left-to-right order, again with 20 µm scale bars, drawn as discrete solid-coloured grains; grains are visibly coarser in AN750-T than in AN850-T. (c) "Average size of DIM": three vertically stacked line plots with shared x-axis "Area weighted score" (0-16) and y-axis "Equivalent circle diameter (µm)" (0-120 top, 0-180 middle, 0-240 bottom); each panel compares a black "Parent grain analysis" curve with a red "Before reconstruction" curve and prints Ave and Δ values. The sequence demonstrates that parent-grain reconstruction yields slightly larger average equivalent circle diameters than the unreconstructed data, and that both sizes decrease as the treatment label changes from AN750-T to AN850-T. Careful: the printed x-axis label "Area weighted score" and y-axis label "Equivalent circle diameter (µm)" are reproduced exactly as shown, though the pairing may be mislabelled by the authors. No caption was supplied.
measured_quantities: difference Δ between parent-grain and before-reconstruction averages

observations.observation: The figure group is composite: (a) and (b) are EBSD-derived grain maps and (c) is a set of three stacked line plots; the panel types are labelled '(a) Before reconstruction', '(b) Parent grain analysis' and '(c) Average size of DIM'.
Panel (a) contains three IPF colour maps labelled AN750-T, AN800-T and AN850-T from left to right, each with a 20 µm scale bar.
An IPF colour triangle inset in panel (a), top right, is labelled 001, 101 and 111.
In panel (a) the grains of AN750-T are relatively equiaxed whereas those of AN800-T and AN850-T are increasingly elongated/banded along the horizontal direction.
Panel (b) shows the corresponding reconstructed parent-grain maps for AN750-T, AN800-T and AN850-T, each with a 20 µm scale bar and coloured grains without any printed colour key.
The reconstructed parent grains in (b) appear appreciably coarser for AN750-T than for AN800-T and AN850-T, i.e. visible grain size decreases as the sample number increases.

Panel (c) plots 'Equivalent circle diameter (µm)' as the vertical axis against 'Area weighted score' (0-16) as the horizontal axis, with axis ranges 0-120, 0-180 and 0-240 µm for the top, middle and bottom sub-plots respectively.
Each sub-plot of (c) contains two curves identified by the legend 'Parent grain analysis' (black) and 'Before reconstruction' (red).
Printed in (c), top sub-plot (AN750-T): Ave = 3.41 (Parent grain analysis) and Ave = 3.29 (Before reconstruction), Δ = 0.12.
Printed in (c), middle sub-plot (AN800-T): Ave = 3.09 and Ave = 2.94, Δ = 0.15.
Printed in (c), bottom sub-plot (AN850-T): Ave = 2.80 and Ave = 2.61, Δ = 0.19.

The printed Ave values decrease monotonically from AN750-T (3.41 / 3.29) through AN800-T (3.09 / 2.94) to AN850-T (2.80 / 2.61), and the difference Δ between the parent-grain-analysis value and the before-reconstruction value increases from 0.12 to 0.19 across the same sequence.

All curves in (c) decay steeply from their maximum at low area weighted score and reach values near the x-axis beyond an area weighted score of roughly 8; the curves of AN850-T begin at a higher equivalent circle diameter on the y-axis than those of AN750-T, the difference being accounted for by the different y-axis ranges.

No caption was available for this figure group, so the meaning of the condition labels AN750-T, AN800-T and AN850-T (apparently annealing temperatures of 750, 800 and 850 °C) is not confirmed by any accompanying text.

subfigures.description: Row of three EBSD inverse pole figure (IPF) colour maps labelled AN750-T (left), AN800-T (middle), AN850-T (right), representing the microstructure 'Before reconstruction'. Each map carries a 20 µm scale bar, and an IPF orientation triangle labelled 001 (top), 101 and 111 is inset at the top right. Grain morphology is equiaxed in AN750-T and increasingly elongated/banded in AN800-T and AN850-T.

Row of three reconstructed parent-grain maps ('Parent grain analysis') for the same AN750-T, AN800-T, AN850-T conditions, each with a 20 µm scale bar. Grains are rendered as discrete solid colours with no orientation triangle; the reconstructed parent grains appear substantially coarser in AN750-T than in AN800-T and AN850-T, and no colour key is provided.

Three stacked line plots titled 'Average size of DIM', sharing the x-axis 'Area weighted score' (0-16) and the y-axis 'Equivalent circle diameter (µm)' with ranges 0-120 (top, AN750-T), 0-180 (middle, AN800-T) and 0-240 (bottom, AN850-T). Each panel has a black 'Parent grain analysis' curve and a red 'Before reconstruction' curve, both decaying rapidly to near zero beyond an area weighted score of about 8. Printed values: AN750-T Ave = 3.41 (black) and Ave = 3.29 (red), Δ = 0.12; AN800-T Ave = 3.09 and Ave = 2.94, Δ = 0.15; AN850-T Ave = 2.80 and Ave = 2.61, Δ = 0.19.
